paragraphs.text: 一款用于显示API余额的DSH桌面版插件
# display-api-balance
English | 中文

Shows the **DeepSeek API balance** as an ambient stat under the DeepSeek Harness
composer and refres

hes it every 60 seconds. Click the balance to set a local
low-balance threshold; the amount turns re
d once it reaches the threshold.
## Features

- Renders in the composer's stat row below the input, after the shipped
"turns · steps · tok/s" and

token-usage stats, sharing their font size, color
and icon style — no separate floating layer.
- Ref

reshes every 60 seconds; also refreshes immediately when the window or tab
regains focus.
- Click th

e balance to open a small panel and set a low-balance threshold
(default ¥20). At or below it the am

ount turns red and bold; leave the field
empty to disable the alert.
- The threshold is a local pref

erence stored in the browser
`localStorage` (`display-api-balance:threshold`); it is never uploaded

or sent
over the network.
- Clear states for a missing `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, a failed request, or a
si

gned-out account — no wrong number is displayed.
- Theme aware: every color comes from DSH's `--dsw-
alias-*` semantic tokens.
## Install

DSH bundles are installed into a profile. From the desktop Plugins page or the
CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then confirm `display-api-balance` is enabled on the Plugins page.

The plugin is distributed from GitHub; there is no npm release yet, so install
with the GitHub spec

above. If it is published to npm later,
`dsh plugin add display-api-balance` will work as well. The

published package's
`repository` field points back at this repository, so marketplaces can map npm
d

package's
`repository` field points back at this repository, so marketplaces can map npm
data to it.
## Requirements

- The host's credential service must resolve `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`: fill in a
DeepSeek API key under DS

H Settings → Models, or export the variable in the
environment that launches DSH.
- DSH version: dev

eloped and verified on `0.2.1-rc.5` (desktop). The host half
only uses `webServer` and `credentials`

; the client half only uses `slots` and
`locale`.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`) registers `GET /api/balance`. Each request
re-resolves the `DEEPSEEK_AP

I_KEY` credential (rotating the key needs no
restart), calls `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`

with
`Authorization: Bearer`, applies a 15-second timeout, and returns the upstream
JSON. The key s

tays inside the host process and is never handed to the
browser.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) reg

isters the balance as one text stat in the
`conversation.composer.dock` slot (`order: 2`, after the

context-occupancy
meter). A relative `fetch('/api/balance')` reaches the host route above
through th

e `dsh-app://` protocol in the desktop app, and as a same-origin
request in the web build.
- For pla

in-HTTP web deployments: like any other host route, `/api/balance` is
meant to be bound to the loopb

yments: like any other host route, `/api/balance` is
meant to be bound to the loopback address only.
## Difference from the old web approach

The web version used `webServer.tapIndex` to inject a DOM script into
`index.html`. The desktop (Ele

ctron) window loads the page from the packaged
`dsh-web-frontend/dist` and never runs the host's `re

nderIndex`, so injected
scripts do not execute there. This plugin renders through a client slot with
React instead, so both the desktop and web builds work.
